I was working out here early, just doing my usual rounds, checking the site. It’s a big building project, you know, lots of work to be done. So I’m walking ’round and I see this lady, right? Asleep right on top of one of the beams. I ain’t never seen her before. Then all of a sudden, she wakes up real startled-like. I ain’t got no idea how she got up there or what she was doing there in the first place. She looked confused, didn’t know where she was. Before I could shout out to her, she lost her balance and just fell. Dropped straight down. Oh man... I ran over quick as I could, but it wasn’t good. She didn’t move much after the fall, so I called for the ambulance right away. I just tried to keep her still ’til they got here. It was a dangerous spot she was in. Real dangerous.
